about: Starter materials with published density and Young's modulus. These are typical handbook or supplier values, rounded as the source prints them: not measurements of any particular string, bar or board. Choose 'custom' in the app to type your own. Add entries here with their source; the app lists them automatically. Each material also has a 'look' (two colours) that only decides how it is drawn on the bench; it is not a physical property.

materials.name: Sitka spruce
materials.note: Along the grain, air-dried to about 12% moisture. Density is the handbook specific gravity (oven-dry basis) converted to 12% moisture; modulus is the handbook bending modulus raised by 10% as the handbook itself advises for the along-grain value.

materials.name: Nylon 6/6
materials.note: Bulk moulded or extruded nylon 6/6, as the data sheet gives it: density 1.14 g/cm³; tensile modulus 350,000 to 425,000 psi (2.4 to 2.9 GPa), here the middle, 2.67 GPa. A drawn guitar-string monofilament is oriented and can be stiffer, and nylon softens as it takes up moisture, so treat it as a starting point and type your own for a particular string.

source.title: CNC Material Data Sheet: Nylon 6/6
source.locator: Properties table: Density, ASTM D792, 1.14 g/cm3; Tensile Modulus, ASTM D638, 350,000-425,000 psi

materials.name: PET film (Mylar)
materials.note: Biaxially oriented polyester film as drum heads are made of. Density is the data sheet's 1.39 g/cc (92 gauge general-use film); the modulus is the 3,800 MPa machine-direction tensile modulus of the 50 micron grade from a manufacturer's data sheet (Tap Plastics prints 710,000 psi for its 92 gauge film, so it varies with grade and direction). A drum head's pitch comes from its mass per area and the tension it is wound to, not its stiffness, so the modulus matters little here.

source.title: Tech Data: Mylar
source.locator: Typical properties: Density, ASTM D1505, 1.39 g/cc (92 gauge general-use film). Modulus: Mylar A 50 to 125 micron data sheet, DuPont Teijin Films, tensile modulus MD 3,800 MPa, https://media.easycomposites.co.uk/datasheets/Mylar_A_50_to_125mic.pdf
